summary: BSR Real Estate Investment Trust filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) covering its unaudited interim financial statements, MD&A and a November 11, 2026 press release announcing third-quarter 2026 results for the period ended September 30, 2026, plus CEO and CFO certifications. No transactional event, stakeholder action or structural change is disclosed. Figures show investment properties of $1.38B, loans and borrowings of $730.9M, a $10.6M nine-month net income and $50.0M of Class B Units; there is nothing to arbitrage or monitor on a deal basis.
